An Sdu Length of 0 can be used to query the current amount of available buffer in the upper layer module. In this case, the Sdu Data Ptr may be a NULL_ PTR. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) buffer Size Ptr Available receive buffer after data has been copied. Return value Buf Req _ - Return - Type BUFREQ_ OK: Data copied successfully BUFREQ_ E_ NOT_ OK: Data was not copied because an error occurred. Description This function is called to provide the received data of an I - PDU segment (N - PDU) to the upper layer. Each call to this function provides the next part of the I - PDU data. T he size of the remaining buffer is written to the position indicated by buffer Size Ptr. Available via <none>
